name: Skyline Millars Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1919, Skyline Millars Ltd is in 
the business of the sale of flats and commercial 
real estate units.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
SML is engaged in the activities relating to Real Estate business. The company has discontinued 
Umreth Division for manufacturing of pipes, hence currently there is only Real Estate Segment.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.24 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -3.94% over last 3 years.
